flows.name: Capital Districts
flows.description: Spectacular Settlements, Capitals, Step 4: the number of districts (modified by size), the districts a governing priority or leadership gives (Economic: Market; Enlightenment: Scholar; Industry & Innovation: Industrial; Religious: Temple; Merchant Monarch: Merchant; Oligarchy: the district that fits its group), each taking one of the rolls, then the rest rolled on District Type. Each district is described by the Capital District flow.
